Remark
[convergence of incomplete manifolds]

Source: petersen:page-0453 ↗ def:pet-ch11-tensor-convergence-compact-subset ↗ cor:pet-ch11-anderson-diffeo-finiteness-injectivity 1. ch11:11.6.7Extend the definition of $C^{m,\alpha }$ convergence to incomplete manifolds, taking the boundary $\partial $ to be the points in the completion but not the manifold. Show that the class of incomplete spaces with $|\Ric |\le \Lambda $ and $\inj (p)\ge \min \{ R,R\cdot d(p,\partial )\} $, $R<1$, is precompact in the $C^{1,\alpha }$ topology.
